records.original_anchor: un vecchio, una giovane ed un bambino
records.source_action: Invite three poor people to represent Joseph Mary and Jesus at a household votive meal
records.statement_en: At Saint Joseph's feast in Ribera, Pitrè described a household table where three poor guests represented the Holy Family.
records.statement_fr: Pour la fête de saint Joseph à Ribera, Pitrè décrit une table familiale où trois hôtes pauvres représentaient la Sainte Famille.

records.source_action: Hang large cudduri loaves on the household walls
records.statement_en: Pitrè's historical description of Saint Joseph's feast in Ribera mentions large decorative breads called cudduri hung on house walls.
records.statement_fr: La description historique de Pitrè sur la fête de saint Joseph à Ribera évoque de grands pains décoratifs appelés cudduri suspendus aux murs des maisons.

records.source_action: Stage a dramatic refusal of shelter at a closed inn door for the costumed Holy Family
records.statement_en: A historical Saint Joseph celebration in Ribera included a dramatic scene in which a costumed Holy Family was refused lodging.
records.statement_fr: Une ancienne fête de saint Joseph à Ribera comprenait une scène où la Sainte Famille costumée se voyait refuser l'hospitalité.

records.source_action: Auction donated food and produce after the church ceremony for the festival cause
records.statement_en: Pitrè described food and agricultural produce being auctioned in Canicattini to support a local Saint Joseph festival.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè a décrit à Canicattini la vente aux enchères d'aliments et de produits agricoles au profit de la fête locale de saint Joseph.

records.source_action: Appoint festival officers to collect laurel boughs outside town and enter on horseback
records.statement_en: Pitrè described a ceremonial Entry of Laurel near Saint Joseph's feast in Ribera, with boughs collected outside town and brought in on horseback.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè a décrit près de la fête de saint Joseph à Ribera une entrée cérémonielle de laurier, dont les branches étaient ramassées hors de la ville puis apportées à cheval.

records.original_anchor: il 19 Marzo e la prima Domenica di Settembre
records.source_action: two historical Joseph observances March and September
records.statement_en: Pitrè recorded two local dates for Saint Joseph festivities in Canicattini: 19 March and the first Sunday in September.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè a relevé deux dates locales de fêtes de saint Joseph à Canicattini : le 19 mars et le premier dimanche de septembre.

records.source_action: Street singers repeat their assigned novena songs for nine consecutive days at the same houses and times
records.statement_en: Pitrè described street singers repeating Saint Rosalia's novena songs at the same Palermo houses for nine days.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrivait des chanteurs reprenant les chants de la neuvaine de sainte Rosalie devant les mêmes maisons de Palerme pendant neuf jours.

records.original_anchor: figura della santa dalle candide vesti
records.source_action: A crowned, white-clad figure of St Rosalia stood high above the historical triumphal cart
records.statement_en: In historical Palermo, the monumental festival cart built for Saint Rosalia over several weeks bore a white-robed, crowned figure of the saint.
records.statement_fr: À Palerme, le grand char préparé pendant plusieurs semaines pour la fête de sainte Rosalie portait une figure de la sainte vêtue de blanc et couronnée.

records.source_action: Spectators watched the fireworks from boats in the gulf adorned with canopies and coloured lanterns
records.statement_en: In historical Palermo, spectators watched fireworks for Saint Rosalia from boats decorated with lanterns.
records.statement_fr: À Palerme, des spectateurs regardaient autrefois les feux d'artifice de sainte Rosalie depuis des bateaux ornés de lanternes.

records.source_action: The church displayed numerous votive tablets recounting injuries and reported favours
records.statement_en: Pitrè described votive tablets in a Palermo church of Saints Cosmas and Damian recounting injuries and reported favours.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrivait, dans une église palermitaine des saints Côme et Damien, des ex-voto relatant des blessures et des faveurs rapportées.

records.source_action: Festival vendors sold edible saints' figurines and confectionery at makeshift stalls
records.statement_en: Historical Palermo festival stalls sold edible sweets shaped like Saints Cosmas and Damian.
records.statement_fr: Des étals de fêtes de l'ancien Palerme vendaient des friandises représentant les saints Côme et Damien.

records.source_action: Fishermen and fishmongers of the Kalsa were privileged to carry the saints' heavy litter
records.statement_en: Pitrè described a group of about fifty fishermen and fishmongers carrying the processional litter of Saints Cosmas and Damian in Palermo.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrit une cinquantaine de pêcheurs et de poissonniers portant le brancard de procession des saints Côme et Damien à Palerme.

records.source_action: Two congregations led hundreds of children carrying small flower-topped water jugs
records.statement_en: Children in a historical Palermo procession of Saints Cosmas and Damian carried small water jugs topped with flowers.
records.statement_fr: Des enfants portaient de petites cruches d'eau ornées de fleurs lors d'une ancienne procession palermitaine des saints Côme et Damien.

records.source_action: The saints' litter was spun repeatedly in rapid circles in the Kalsa district
records.statement_en: The bearers of Saints Cosmas and Damian's statues spun their litter rapidly in circles in Palermo's Kalsa quarter.
records.statement_fr: Les porteurs des statues des saints Côme et Damien faisaient tournoyer leur brancard dans le quartier de la Kalsa, à Palerme.

records.source_action: A ceremonial horse cavalcade represented Count Roger's entry, with a senior participant carrying a copy of the banner
records.statement_en: A historical Assumption cavalcade in Piazza Armerina reenacted Count Roger's entry and carried a copy of a Marian banner.
records.statement_fr: Une ancienne cavalcade de l'Assomption à Piazza Armerina reconstituait l'entrée du comte Roger et portait une copie d'une bannière mariale.

records.source_action: In the annual procession a senior lawyer announced stops using a silver bell
records.statement_en: During an old Assumption procession at Piazza Armerina, a senior lawyer rang a silver bell to signal stops.
records.statement_fr: Lors d'une ancienne procession de l'Assomption à Piazza Armerina, un avocat de haut rang agitait une cloche d'argent pour signaler les haltes.

records.source_action: The Holy Spirit celebration fell at Pentecost after seven preceding Thursdays treated as separate festival observances.
records.statement_en: Pitrè described a Holy Spirit feast at Gangi preceded by celebrations on seven successive Thursdays.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrivait à Gangi une fête du Saint-Esprit précédée de célébrations pendant sept jeudis successifs.

records.source_action: The patron's image stopped at each household seeking offerings in money, grain, beans, oil, wine or eggs.
records.statement_en: At Gratteri, Pitrè described Saint James's statue being taken to houses to collect offerings that included money, grain, barley and broad beans.
records.statement_fr: À Gratteri, Pitrè décrit la statue de saint Jacques portée de maison en maison pour recueillir notamment de l'argent, du grain, de l'orge et des fèves.

records.source_action: The image also visited rural growers who wanted the patron's presence among orchards and gardens.
records.statement_en: Pitrè reported the statue of Saint James visiting orchards and gardens near Gratteri as well as houses.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè relatait comment la statue de saint Jacques visitait aussi les vergers et les jardins des environs de Gratteri.

records.source_action: Visitors offered selected grape clusters, tying them to the silver staff of the saint's image.
records.statement_en: An old Saint James celebration in Gratteri included grape clusters tied to the statue's silver staff.
records.statement_fr: Une ancienne fête de saint Jacques à Gratteri comprenait des grappes de raisin attachées au bâton d'argent de sa statue.

records.source_action: The third Sunday of each month honoured the Blessed Sacrament under sponsorship of a different local social or occupational group.
records.statement_en: Pitrè described different occupational groups taking turns sponsoring monthly Blessed Sacrament observances in Geraci Siculo.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrivait à Geraci Siculo des groupes professionnels se relayant pour organiser des célébrations mensuelles du Saint-Sacrement.

records.source_action: The third Sunday of June was assigned to shepherds, whose celebration uniquely featured a mounted cavalcade.
records.statement_en: Shepherds in Geraci Siculo held a mounted cavalcade for their historical June Blessed Sacrament celebration.
records.statement_fr: Les bergers de Geraci Siculo organisaient une cavalcade lors de leur ancienne célébration de juin en l'honneur du Saint-Sacrement.

records.source_action: Younger shepherds carried ribboned umbrella-shaped frames holding small animal-shaped caciocavalli.
records.statement_en: Young shepherds once carried ribboned frames decorated with small animal-shaped caciocavalli cheeses in Geraci Siculo.
records.statement_fr: De jeunes bergers portaient autrefois à Geraci Siculo des armatures ornées de rubans et de petits fromages caciocavalli en forme d'animaux.

records.source_action: A banner sent by emigrants in America was added to the mounted offering procession.
records.statement_en: An emigrant community in America once sent a banner for a Saint Cyrus festival in Marineo, Sicily.
records.statement_fr: Une communauté d'émigrés installée en Amérique envoya autrefois une bannière pour la fête de saint Cyr à Marineo, en Sicile.

records.source_action: Named confraternities made public wax offerings; a chaplain said Mass in the saint's chapel for them
records.statement_en: Historical confraternities offered wax publicly for Saint Rosalia's feast in Palermo.
records.statement_fr: Des confréries offraient publiquement de la cire pour la fête de sainte Rosalie à Palerme.

records.original_anchor: la festa si ripete in chiesa
records.source_action: Pitrè distinguishes restrictions on the public procession from continuation of the feast inside the church
records.statement_en: Pitrè distinguished a local prohibition on the public procession of Saints Cosmas and Damian from continued celebrations inside their church.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè distinguait une interdiction locale de procession publique des saints Côme et Damien du maintien de leur fête à l'intérieur de l'église.

records.source_action: Ornately assembled fruit stalls included watercolour scenes of the saints' procession and martyrdom
records.statement_en: Some old Palermo festival fruit stalls displayed painted scenes from the lives of Saints Cosmas and Damian.
records.statement_fr: Certains anciens étals de fruits des fêtes de Palerme présentaient des scènes peintes de la vie des saints Côme et Damien.

records.source_action: The Marian banner was covered with worked silver and devotional jewels
records.statement_en: The historical Marian banner of Piazza Armerina was described as adorned with silverwork and devotional jewels.
records.statement_fr: L'ancienne bannière mariale de Piazza Armerina était décrite comme ornée d'argent ouvragé et de bijoux votifs.

records.source_action: Before suppression of religious houses, nuns arranged temporary altars as stopping places and hosted civic representatives
records.statement_en: Pitrè recounts that nuns once arranged temporary altars as stopping places during celebrations in Piazza Armerina.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè rapporte que des religieuses dressaient autrefois des autels temporaires comme étapes de célébrations à Piazza Armerina.

records.source_action: Nine confraternities participated, said to number roughly four hundred members each in the described observance.
records.statement_en: Pitrè describes nine confraternities participating in an old Holy Spirit celebration in Gangi.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè décrit neuf confréries participant à une ancienne fête du Saint-Esprit à Gangi.

records.source_action: Households prepared festival gifts by milking their animals and cooking a soft dairy mixture.
records.statement_en: Pitrè records Geraci Siculo households preparing a dairy-based festival gift for a local Blessed Sacrament celebration.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè relate qu'à Geraci Siculo des familles préparaient un présent à base de lait pour une fête locale du Saint-Sacrement.

records.source_action: Older shepherds carried ribbon-tied bunches of wax instead of the dairy display frames.
records.statement_en: Older shepherds in a historical Geraci Siculo cavalcade carried bunches of wax tied with ribbons.
records.statement_fr: De vieux bergers portaient des bouquets de cire noués de rubans lors d'une ancienne cavalcade à Geraci Siculo.

records.source_action: At town squares youths recited occasional verses honouring the Eucharist as the cavalcade passed under arches and falling flowers.
records.statement_en: Pitrè recorded young people reciting verses in honour of the Eucharist as the Geraci Siculo cavalcade passed through town squares.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè relatait comment des jeunes déclamaient des vers en l'honneur de l'Eucharistie lors du passage de la cavalcade de Geraci Siculo sur les places.

records.original_anchor: vestito da angelo per un anello
records.source_action: At a designated procession halt a costumed child playing an angel was carried along a rope toward the statue, recited a hymn or prayer, and withdrew.
records.statement_en: At a historical Saint Cyrus festival in Marineo, a child dressed as an angel descended on a rope to recite a prayer before the saint's statue.
records.statement_fr: Lors d'une ancienne fête de saint Cyr à Marineo, un enfant déguisé en ange descendait le long d'une corde pour réciter une prière devant la statue du saint.

records.original_anchor: sulle pubbliche vie e sulle piazze
records.source_action: The Dimostranza presented scenes of a saint's life in public streets and squares using local, nonprofessional performers.
records.statement_en: In Marineo, the historical Saint Cyrus street drama, called the Dimostranza, featured townspeople acting as soldiers, hermits, angels and even personified virtues and vices.
records.statement_fr: À Marineo, l'ancienne représentation de rue consacrée à saint Cyr, la Dimostranza, réunissait des habitants jouant des soldats, des ermites, des anges et même des vertus et des vices personnifiés.

records.source_action: Altavilla Loreto pilgrims carried long decorated vow candles proportional to their height
records.statement_en: At Altavilla in Sicily, pilgrims carried decorated votive candles so long that some matched their own height.
records.statement_fr: À Altavilla, en Sicile, des pèlerins portaient des cierges votifs décorés dont certains atteignaient leur propre taille.

records.source_action: The Altavilla Loreto feast received wax-anatomical and hair ex-voto offerings
records.statement_en: At Altavilla's Loreto shrine, historical ex-votos included wax models of body parts and offerings of hair.
records.statement_fr: Au sanctuaire de Lorette d'Altavilla, les ex-voto anciens comprenaient des parties du corps modelées en cire et des offrandes de cheveux.

records.source_action: The Monreale Crucifix statue-bearing privilege was described as inheritable through specified family lines
records.statement_en: In Monreale, the right to carry the Crucifix's processional poles was once associated with particular family lineages.
records.statement_fr: À Monreale, le droit de porter les brancards du Crucifix en procession était jadis lié à certaines lignées familiales.

records.statement_en: At Monreale, an old Crucifix procession repeated a Sicilian invocation between recitations of the Gloria Patri.
records.statement_fr: À Monreale, une ancienne procession du Crucifix répétait une invocation sicilienne entre des Gloria Patri.

records.source_action: Girls dressed as saints or angels preceded a Crucifix procession and scattered flowers along its route
records.statement_en: In one Sicilian Crucifix procession, girls dressed as saints or angels walked ahead and scattered flowers.
records.statement_fr: Dans une procession sicilienne du Crucifix, des filles vêtues en saintes ou en anges ouvraient la marche en répandant des fleurs.

records.source_action: Married statue-bearers initially controlled processional carrying poles in Francofonte
records.statement_en: In Francofonte, married men once held the initial privilege of carrying Saint Sebastian's processional poles.
records.statement_fr: À Francofonte, les hommes mariés détenaient autrefois le privilège initial de porter les brancards de saint Sébastien.

records.source_action: The reliquary urn passed between ranks of lit votive structures as devotees knelt
records.statement_en: At Noto's historical Saint Conrad procession, a drummer summoned bearers of tall votive candles, and the saint's reliquary passed between two rows of lights as devotees knelt.
records.statement_fr: Lors de l'ancienne procession de saint Conrad à Noto, un tambour appelait les porteurs de grands cierges votifs ; le reliquaire du saint passait entre deux rangées de lumières tandis que les fidèles s'agenouillaient.

records.source_action: Modica St George festivities included a statue decorated with gifts and broad-bean plants
records.statement_en: Some Saint George festivities in Modica displayed broad-bean plants among the gifts decorating the statue.
records.statement_fr: Lors de certaines fêtes de saint Georges à Modica, des plants de fèves figuraient parmi les dons ornant la statue.

records.source_action: Fava stalks and cereal ears were fastened behind the Crucifix while devotees carried flower-adorned long candles
records.statement_en: At Santa Margherita, devotees fastened fava stalks and grain ears behind the Crucifix during a historical celebration.
records.statement_fr: À Santa Margherita, les fidèles fixaient autrefois des tiges de fèves et des épis derrière le Crucifix lors de la fête.

records.source_action: A pulley lifted the Madonna delle Mortelle statue behind the altar during the eve of feast Vespers
records.statement_en: A historical Sicilian Marian celebration at Villafranca used a pulley to raise the Madonna delle Mortelle image behind the altar during Vespers.
records.statement_fr: Lors d'une ancienne fête mariale à Villafranca, en Sicile, une poulie hissait l'image de la Madonna delle Mortelle derrière l'autel pendant les vêpres.

records.source_action: St Angelo devotions included a musical oratorio performed in church by civic and maritime communities
records.statement_en: The historical Saint Angelo festivities at Licata included a musical oratorio performed inside a church.
records.statement_fr: Les anciennes fêtes de saint Ange à Licata comprenaient un oratorio musical exécuté dans une église.

records.source_action: Large devotional candle structures called cilii were historically carried in Racalmuto processions
records.statement_en: At old Marian processions in Racalmuto, elaborate candle structures called cilii appeared; a contest winner had to pay to have one illuminated.
records.statement_fr: Dans les anciennes processions mariales de Racalmuto figuraient de grandes structures à cierges, les cilii ; le gagnant d'un concours devait payer lui-même leur illumination.

records.source_action: Sambuca pilgrims carried enough lights that the Marian procession was compared to a flowing river of fire
records.statement_en: Pitrè recorded a three-day Marian festival at Sambuca, where pilgrims' procession lights were likened to a river of fire.
records.statement_fr: Pitrè a décrit à Sambuca une fête mariale de trois jours, dont les lumières portées en procession par les pèlerins évoquaient un fleuve de feu.

records.source_action: Girls sang a local Rosary verse in front of home altars during the Marian celebrations
records.statement_en: During a Marian feast near Alcamo, girls sang a Rosary verse in front of small altars inside homes.
records.statement_fr: Lors d'une fête mariale près d'Alcamo, des filles chantaient un verset du Rosaire devant de petits autels domestiques.
